about: GTA 6 unlock times (Delta, pillar 6). PlayStation Store listings read 2026-11-16 (concept 10000730): NZ 2026-11-18T11:00Z (midnight NZDT), AU 13:00Z (midnight AEDT), JP 15:00Z (midnight JST), GB 2026-11-19T00:00Z (midnight GMT), US 05:00Z (midnight EST = 9 PM PST Nov 18). NZ to US = 18 h. PlayStation US support: releases at midnight local time Nov 19 on PS5. Xbox times not used (no primary). Voice is date-proof for posting Nov 16-18: no today/tomorrow. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: G T A six starts in New Zealand.

lines.text: On PlayStation, each store unlocks at its own midnight.
